name: treasure-of-the-depths-end-phase-with-three-water-cards-adds-a-refinement-counter
notes: The Deluge 3 end-phase trigger had no implementation. Added to BeforeEndPhase(): with Deluge 3 met (three or more water cards in the graveyard) and fewer than three refinement counters, put a refinement counter on it.

rulesClauses: Deluge 3 -- At the beginning of your end phase, if there are three or more water element cards in your graveyard and there are less than three refinement counters on CARDNAME, put a refinement counter on CARDNAME.

engineBug.summary: Treasure of the Depths never gained refinement counters.
